## b8d99a6f466a

**Reproduced defect — global-separator shortcut.** The audited generator hash `bd7361e130d379d4924684e97ec7a617d4130bf54a7554201859e53cbe5cfd81` only produced rooms separated by a full-width horizontal colour-1 line, optionally plus a full-height vertical line. A rival rule, `full_separator_only`, performs the intended chamber fill only when it sees such a global separator; otherwise it returns the input unchanged.

That rival fit **24/24 generated cases** (seeds 5000–5023, sample indices 0–23, round-robin easy/medium/hard), yet failed canonical pair 0, whose two rooms are local closed rectangles rather than global slabs. The canonical input passes the target `self_check`. Canonical Racket rule hash `a53a6185cfe6` fills the interiors with marker colours 3 and 7, while the rival leaves both interiors mostly zero.

Evidence: `checks/audit/b8d99a6f466a/probe_meta.json`, `input.json`, `racket.json`, and `rival.json`. The Racket output was obtained with the supported `arcpuzzles apply` command recorded inside `racket.json`. No source was changed because audit targets are findings-only.
